log_tail: - **`aws_devops.s3_object_storage_operations`** combines object-storage operations, access authorization, and lifecycle policies. Access-policy correctness and lifecycle expiration/transition behavior are independently configurable and assessed. Narrow this candidate to one bounded S3 operation—for example, **“Configuring S3 object lifecycle expiration and transitions”**—and do not claim that it also teaches authorization. Existing IAM candidates can supply prerequisite authorization coverage.

- **`aws_devops.secrets_manager_operations`** combines secret-access authorization with secret rotation. A workload can have correct retrieval permissions while rotation fails, or successful rotation while workload access fails. Narrow it to **“Configuring and validating Secrets Manager rotation”**, treating the existing IAM candidates as prerequisites rather than bundling access-policy authoring into this objective.

- **`aws_devops.runtime_failure_diagnostics`** is an umbrella spanning compute, containers, and managed databases; its container portion also overlaps `aws_devops.docker_container_diagnostics`. Replace the broad claim with one specific diagnostic objective, such as **“Diagnosing EC2 instance and system status-check failures”**, and remove container diagnosis from this candidate. Managed-database diagnosis must not remain implicitly bundled into the narrowed concept.
These narrowing corrections require no additional concepts or families. Any alternative that preserves the bundled breadth must fund its splits with named cuts and remain within both ceilings.
